title: EventLanes draws every mark at one size, so it cannot show how much of something an event carries
foundBy: repository owner, designing an event strip that shows how long each event took and how long the work waited between turns
details:
An `EventLaneEvent` carries a kind, a shape and a few overlays, and no quantity. Every mark is drawn at the size `markSizeFor` gives the cell, so a two-second step and a two-minute one look the same. Colour is already spent on the kind, so a consumer has nowhere to put a magnitude.

The layout is fixed too. Every lane is 28 pixels high, and the overview is 40, which outweighs a strip of one or two lanes.

The component should accept an optional magnitude from 0 to 1 on an event. A lane option should draw its events as bars, rising from the lane's floor or hanging from its top. An event past the consumer's ceiling should carry the broken-bar notch. Lane height and overview height should be settable.

Every addition must be optional and default to today's drawing, so the existing visual baselines stay byte-identical.
